title: intellisense Change Contract
description: Schema for the front matter of .intellisense/contracts/<branch>.md — the branch's change contract, committed with the change, validated by scripts/validate-contract-schema.sh and enforced by hooks/pre-push (Tier 1+) and scripts/preToolUse-contract-gate.sh (Phase 1+ runtime gate).

branch.description: Output of `git symbolic-ref --short HEAD`. Validator rejects if it differs from the current branch (stale-contract check).

mode.description: Detected mode from Phase 0.5 (or classifier output for the same).

requirement.description: One-sentence restatement of what the user asked for.

files_affected.description: Flat array of repo-relative paths the change will touch. Must NOT be nested under a `scope` object.

estimated_lines.description: Numeric estimate of total lines changed (additions + deletions).

confidence_score.description: Decimal 0.0-1.0. Gate Rule R3 rejects contracts with confidence_score < 0.75.

risk_level.description: Gate Rule R1: low is rejected when high_risk_files_touched is non-empty.

financial_impact.description: True when the change affects payment, account, payout, invoice, tax, or other money-typed paths. Gate Rule R5: true requires mode=full_feature (auto-escalation if classifier sees financial+bug_fix).

high_risk_files_touched.description: Files listed in knowledge-base/risk-register.md OR files the developer has marked as load-bearing infrastructure. Each entry should be `<path> — <why it's risky>`.

protected_files_touched.description: Migrations, config files, vendor/* files, .env files. Gate Rule R2: non-empty array requires approval_received_at to be set.

rollback_strategy.description: Exact steps to undo. 'Revert commit' is acceptable when no data migrations exist.

test_strategy.description: What tests will be written or modified, and why those tests verify the change.

approval_received_at.description: ISO timestamp when protected_files_touched is non-empty (Gate Rule R2). Empty string otherwise. Conditionally required by validator.

session_id.description: Claude Code session_id captured when /contract produced this artifact. Together with `prompt_hash` and `classification_id`, this binds the contract to a specific TASK rather than to a branch. Without task binding, an old contract from yesterday's work on the same branch could silently validate today's unrelated edits.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 prefix of the user prompt that produced the current classification, captured at /contract creation time. Pairs with `classification_id` to detect task drift. Stable across re-runs of /contract on the same prompt; changes on a new prompt.

classification_id.description: Identifier of the classification used to scope this contract — written by the classifier into .intellisense/session/<session_id>.classification.json. PreToolUse gate compares this to the CURRENT classification at edit time; mismatch = wrong task (Gate Rule R7). Pilot warns on mismatch; enforced blocks.

state.description: Contract lifecycle state (audit-chain hardening 2026-05-20). draft → /contract just produced the file. presented → Claude has shown the contract to the user. approved → user explicitly said proceed; first valid edit is now permitted. active → at least one edit under this contract has succeeded. retroactive / evidence_only → reviewer-evidence artifacts produced post-hoc (audit, triage, after-the-fact reconstruction); they validate schema-clean but never unlock edits. Gate Rule R6 is context-aware: R6 (edit, PreToolUse default) requires state ∈ {approved, active}; R6 (evidence, pre-push) additionally accepts {retroactive, evidence_only}. draft and presented are rejected in both contexts. The gate auto-transitions approved → active on the first successful Edit/Write.

evidence_used.description: Documentation-only field: how the affected-files list was derived (grep results, git log findings, etc.). Not enforced by validator; useful for human review.

knowledge_base_files_read.description: Documentation-only field: which repo docs were consulted before scoping the change.

repo_patterns_checked.description: Documentation-only field: coding patterns the implementation will follow (e.g., 'parameterized SQL', 'error wrapping').

why_scope_is_limited.description: Documentation-only field: one sentence justifying why the scope can't be reduced further.

impact_analysis.description: Documentation-only field (Impact Discovery). Caller/downstream evidence gathered during /plan Impact Discovery — captures graph who-calls + change-spread output, or rg fallback output, or the literal string 'n/a — graph unavailable' / 'n/a — weak stack'. Validator emits a warn-only message at push time when Tier 1/2 contract has this field empty/missing.

impact_analysis_dismissed_suggestions.description: Documentation-only field (Impact Discovery). Free-text reason when developer marks a graph-suggested caller as `dismissed` or `verified_unchanged`. One line per suggestion: '<file>: <reason>'.
